chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Abu Dawud Sulayman ibn Sufyan al-Mustariq, from some of our companions, from Muthanna al-Hannat, from Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him saying: Whoever visits the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), knowing his right, Allah will forgive him for what preceded of his sin and what followed.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn with knowledge of his rights?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records this narration from Imam Musa al-Kazim (a.s.), emphasizing that 'knowing his rights' (ta'arruf li-haqqihi) is the crucial condition for the grant of complete forgiveness. This highlights the Shia theological principle that spiritual merit in ziyarah is contingent upon deep gnosis of the Imam's station, rather than mere physical presence. The promise of forgiveness for both past and future sins underscores the transformative power of connecting with the Ahl al-Bayt through informed devotion.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 5. Abul ‘Abbās narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain, from Abī Dāwūd Sulaymān ibn Sufyān Al-Mustariq, from some of our companions, from Muthannā Al-Ḥannāť, who said:
I heard Abal Ḥasan, Mūsā ibn Ja’far (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)) say: Allāh will forgive all of the past and future sins of those who go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) knowing his rights.
